description_en: Checks the CNAME resolution of accelerated domain names to determine whether CNAME configuration is complete
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainCname对加速域名CNAME进行解析检测，查看解析结果判断是否完成CNAME配置
name: DescribeDcdnDomainCname

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 domain names in a single query
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，多个以逗号（,）分隔，单次查询最多支持30个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

Cname.description_en: The CNAME assigned to the domain name by Alibaba Cloud DCDN

ErrMsg.description_en: The error message returned when the CNAME assigned to the domain name does not pass the DNS resolution check or times out
ErrMsg.description_zh: 通过域名解析检测到分配给域名的cname不通过或超时的错误信息

Passed.description_en:
Indicates whether the CNAME assigned to the domain name passes the DNS resolution check. Valid values:
true: Passed.
false: Not passed.
timeout: Timed out
Passed.description_zh:
通过域名解析检测到分配给域名的cname是否通过，取值：
true: 通过
false: 不通过
timeout: 超时

Status.description_en:
The CNAME configuration status. A value of 0 indicates success. Other values indicate configuration errors.

0: The CNAME assigned to the domain name is detected through DNS resolution.
1: The CNAME assigned to the domain name is not yet detected through DNS resolution.
-1: The CNAME assigned to the domain name is not detected through DNS resolution due to a timeout
Status.description_zh:
CNAME配置状态，返回0表示成功，返回其他数字表示配置错误。

0：表示通过域名解析检测到分配给域名的CNAME。
1：表示通过域名解析暂未监测到分配给域名的CNAME。
-1：表示通过域名解析暂未监测到分配给域名的CNAME 超时
